purpose: measure the ENGINE'S OWN product attacker (discovery_fabric/engine/independent_attack.py, independent_attack/1.0.0) on the sealed 40-case calibration corpus, closing the binding gap between the R412 measurement (which measured the sibling r411 8-surface protocol) and the instrument that actually gates the product's standard gauntlet and the R416 evolution loop

sealed_corpus.rule: preflight verifies the corpus sha256 against the seal before any attack; a mutated corpus aborts the pass (Art. VIII); the corpus is UNTOUCHED by this pass

instrument.modification: NONE — the instrument is imported and called exactly as the product path calls it (Art. LIX: no tuning between or during passes)
consumers_of_this_instrument: the R416 evolution loop per-generation challenge (run.py::_evolution_pipeline)

input_mapping.rule: the sealed corpus case fields map onto the engine instrument's candidate/problem/evidence inputs as follows; the mapping is part of THIS preregistration, fixed before the run
input_mapping.candidate.mechanism: corpus candidate.causal_chain (a list — rendered as ' -> '.join(links), the author-intended chain text)
input_mapping.problem.device: corpus candidate.baseline.baseline_incumbent (the status quo the candidate must beat — exactly what the engine prompt's Baseline field means)
input_mapping.evidence: corpus pool records, mapped to {id: record_id, title: title}
input_mapping.generator_provider: null — no generator to separate from (the corpus is deterministically authored; the instrument's independence_mode stays as it computes, honestly labelled)

instrument_scope_disclosure.prior_art: the engine instrument has NO prior-art attack class: the product delegates prior-art collision to the deterministic collision instrument (prior_art_v2). The PRIOR_ART_COLLISION cohort (10 cases) is therefore measured as COVERAGE, not as a pass/fail surface of this instrument: an engine-instrument non-kill on those cases is recorded as EXPECTED_NOT_COVERED (a coverage boundary of the instrument, disclosed — never a silent miss and never an excuse)

tpo_denominators.sealed_30: ALL defect cases (KNOWN_BAD + NEAR_MISS + PRIOR_ART_COLLISION) — the conservative threshold-comparison denominator: a PRIOR_ART_COLLISION miss counts as a miss
tpo_denominators.scoped_20: KNOWN_BAD + NEAR_MISS only (the classes the instrument actually attacks) — reported as a diagnostic

instrument_scope_disclosure.fpr_denominator: the 10 KNOWN_GOOD cases (unchanged from the seal)

thresholds.source: byte-copied from R412/CALIBRATION/r412_calibration_seal.json at run time — never hardcoded here (Art. XXVII)
thresholds.tuning_rule: no threshold, prompt, or protocol change after results are seen (Art. LIX)

transport.confound_disclosure: the deployed product attacker routes through the model-routing registry (nvidia family at deploy time); this pass measures the instrument PROTOCOL at the sandbox's one live transport. The sibling-protocol family evidence (r411 8-surface: FPR 0.80 minimax-m3 / 1.00 glm-4-plus, cross-model agreement 1.0) covers two models; the engine protocol is measured at one. No pure model-family attribution is claimed.

prediction_before_the_run.falsifiable_claim: based on the measured family evidence (hostile DESTROY-class protocols kill 80-100% of sealed KNOWN_GOOD cases), the engine 6-class protocol is PREDICTED to exceed the FPR bar (FPR > 0.30) — i.e. the expected verdict is NOT_CALIBRATED
prediction_before_the_run.the_falsifying_outcome: CALIBRATED (FPR <= 0.30 at TPR >= 0.75) would falsify the family-generalization claim and will be recorded as such, with the difference analyzed (the 6-class basis-validated protocol is narrower than the 8-surface protocol — it validates KILL bases and omits prior_art/commercial/experiment surfaces)
prediction_before_the_run.why_this_is_preregistered: Art. XXXII: the strongest alternative explanation is stated and testable BEFORE the measurement, not selected after

outputs.checkpoint_jsonl: R412/CALIBRATION/runs/engine-independent.jsonl (append-only, resume-safe, INCOMPLETE re-queued within the bounded retry budget — Art. LXI)
outputs.measurement_record: R412/CALIBRATION/engine_independent_attack_measurement.json (a NEW artifact; the sealed r412_attacker_measurement.json is never rewritten)
